additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441166-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / S1 170003201]  Update latest firmware version CRM:02682000269
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Pratheesh Paulraj,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0441166
. The ticket was opened for a support request to update the FW of charger
MP/S1 170003201
to the latest version (v7.0.5)
When I received the ticket, the charger was on FW v3.2.8. I updated the charger to v4.0.11 and I rolled out FW v5.0.23.
The FW update v5.0.23 is available on SCB to be launched, but the charger is offline from Siemens Backend since 02.08.2025. I believe, the data plan on the SIM card of Siemens router could be extinguished.
Could you please check that the SIM card installed in the Siemens router XF3 has enough data to perform the remaining OTA updates?
Please consider that, as per request, the following updates need to be performed:
Rollout and update to v6.1.3 (2GB)
Rollout and update to v7.0.5 (2GB)
In case the rollout of v5.0.23 was interrupted due to extinction of data plan, another rollout should be performed of 5.0.23 (2GB)
Looking forward to hearing your kind feedback.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
